metrics.p14Reconstructed: count of ground-truth tasks whose six usage sets reconstruct exactly
metrics.p15Groups: count of repetition/diversity feature groups whose raw and derived metrics match
metrics.p16Attributed: count of seeded failure cases whose outcome, causal mode and causes match
metrics.deniedNegativeCases: count of missing, late, replayed, cross-scope, tampered and attribution-invalid cases denied

requiredInvariants: P14 returns searched, inspected, used, rejected, decision-supporting and outcome-contributing Knowledge, not inferred substitutes.
P15 counts identical repetitions as occurrences but removes them from distinct joint usage units and does not emit +G without two task semantics and two contexts.
P16 accepts only explicit bounded witnesses and retains CONFIRMED, SUPPORTED, POSSIBLE, UNKNOWN and multi-cause modes.
Missing, late, replayed, cross-scope and tampered lineage is denied before any partial score is emitted.
Source, applicability, freshness, contradiction, generalization and operational profile dimensions remain separate.
Every accepted result is compared with independently authored ground truth and repeated from a fresh input copy.
noSubstitutionRule: A repeated observation, outcome contribution, profile dimension or fixture declaration cannot substitute for missing lineage, causal witness, source applicability, freshness, contradiction or independent generalization evidence.
